qualification.education_qualification: Intermediate Science, Matriculation, Bachelor of Physical Education, Graduate/Post Graduate in Psychology.
qualification.details: Lab Assistant (Chemistry): Essential: Intermediate Science or equivalent in the subject. Desirable: Higher qualification will be preferred. Ward Boys: Essential: Matriculation. Desirable: 1. Higher Qualification. 2. Proficiency in spoken English and sports. 3. Basic knowledge in Computers and First Aid. Band Master: Essential: Potential Band Master/Band Major/Drum Major course at the AEC Training and Centre, Pachmarhi or eqvt. Naval/Air Force Courses. Desirable: Proficiency in sports and extra-curricular activities. PEM/PTI-cum-Matron (Female): Essential: Bachelor of Physical Education (B.P.Ed) - 4 yrs Degree Course. OR Three years Graduation + One year B.P.Ed Diploma. OR B.Sc Physical Education; Health Education & Sports + One year B.P.Ed Diploma. Desirable: 1. Experience of working in Residential schools as Warden/Matron. 2. Proficiency in sports/ participation in State and/or National level in any sport. 3. NCC certificate holder. Counselor: Essential: Graduate/Post Graduate in Psychology OR Post Graduate in Child Development OR Graduate/Post Graduate with Diploma in Counseling, with at least 50% marks. Desirable: 1. Minimum of One year Experience in Providing Career/ Educational Counseling to students at schools. 2. Working knowledge and experience in placement Bureaus. 3. Registration with Rehabilitation Council of India as Vocational. 4. Interested in other extracurricular activities and aptitude for residential school life style.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Sainik School Nagrota Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the various posts at Sainik School Nagrota is 25th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the school before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Sainik School Nagrota Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 8 vacancies announced for various posts at Sainik School Nagrota. These include positions like Lab Assistant, Ward Boys, Band Master, PEM/PTI-cum-Matron, and Counselor.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum educational qualification required for the Ward Boys post?
faq.answer: The minimum educational qualification required for the Ward Boys post is Matriculation (10th pass). Desirable qualifications include proficiency in spoken English, sports, and basic computer and first aid knowledge.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the PEM/PTI-cum-Matron (Female) post?
faq.answer: The age limit for the PEM/PTI-cum-Matron (Female) post is a minimum of 21 years and a maximum of 50 years. Specific age relaxations may apply as per government rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Counselor post?
faq.answer: The Counselor post offers a monthly salary of Rs. 35,000/-. This includes rent-free accommodation and free messing with cadets, applicable during the working period.

faq.question: Q6. Is the application process for Sainik School Nagrota Recruitment 2026 online or offline?
faq.answer: The application process for Sainik School Nagrota Recruitment 2026 is offline. Candidates need to download the application form, fill it, and send it to the official address via post.

faq.question: Q7. What are the essential qualifications for the Lab Assistant (Chemistry) position?
faq.answer: The essential qualification for the Lab Assistant (Chemistry) post is Intermediate Science or an equivalent qualification in the subject. Higher qualifications are considered desirable.

faq.question: Q8. Does Sainik School Nagrota offer accommodation for the selected candidates?
faq.answer: Yes, the salary details mention that selected candidates will be provided with rent-free suitable accommodation. This applies to most of the posts advertised.

faq.answer: The official website for Sainik School Nagrota recruitment is www.sainikschoolnagrota.com. Candidates can visit this site for further details and to download the application form.
